newsitem.title: USA: Sun Health Care sees 1998 revs over $3 bln.
newsitem.headline: Sun Health Care sees 1998 revs over $3 bln.

text.p: Sun Health Care Group Inc said Sunday that it expected annualized revenues in excess of $3 billion in 1998.
The company said it made the projection in light of its planned acquisition of Regency Health Services Inc, and its pending acquisition of Retirement Care Associates Inc

Sun said that upon completion of the two acquisitions, the company will operate 510 long-term care facilities in the United States and Britain, with a total of 49,141 beds, and 47 assisted living facilities, with 4,583 units.
Considering both acquisitions, Sun said it will employ more than 72,000 people in the United States and Britain.
